entities.summary: Bemba Kingdom, a political institution in Zambia during Pre-Colonial Kingdoms and Chiefdoms (1700–1900). Grew from Lozi Kingdom and Lozi Kingdom Barotseland. Led to the emergence of Eastern Lunda Kingdom and Lunda-Kazembe Kingdom.
